title: A turn in progress shows a working line above the prompt
body:
While a prompt turn runs, the only sign of it is the state item at the right end of the status line. `state` in `header.rs` draws `◐ working` in yellow while `app.transcript.in_flight` is set, stepping through `SPINNER` every `SPIN_INTERVAL` (150 ms, in `app.rs`). Otherwise it draws `idle`, or `idle, <stop reason>` when a turn ended with something other than `EndTurn`. The status line is dim and sits under the prompt, so it is easy to miss that the agent is still working.

## Proposal

While `in_flight` is set, `ui::draw` gives one row between the transcript and the prompt to a working line: the spinner and the word `working`. The row goes away when the turn ends. Claude Code draws a line like this in the same place.

## Open

- Does the line carry more than the spinner, such as the time since the prompt was sent or the key that cancels the turn?
- Does the status line keep its `working` item, or show only `idle` and the stop reason once the working line exists?
- Does a pending permission request change the line, for example to say the agent is waiting on you?
